$comment: Classified baseline of every system the mobile/continuity/notification program touches. Classifications: existing_reuse | existing_extend | existing_repair | missing_build | duplicate_remove | intentionally_out_of_scope | externally_blocked | needs_owner_decision. Derived from a one-time bounded reconnaissance (three read-only surveys + one design pass) at base_commit 78562dd. Hand-maintained.

systems.name: notification_intelligence
systems.detail: Inbox (table notification_inbox), lifecycle engine, policy engine, delivery router, channel gateway (slack/discord/telegram/webhook), audit; routes /v1/notifications. Extend: brand canonical, add TS twins, coverage registry, mobile projection. Do NOT build a second inbox.

systems.name: notification_legacy_alerts
systems.detail: Legacy router mounted at the SAME /v1/notifications prefix; its /webhooks + /alerts are already shadowed by identical stubs in notification_intelligence. Unmount in C2; keep module as deprecated dead code.

systems.name: delivery
systems.detail: DeliveryIntent->DeliveryJob(lease)->DeliveryWorker->ProviderAdapter->ProviderReceipt->outcome. ProviderReceipt already rejects empty/'sim-' ids. Adapters: slack/discord/telegram/webhook/linear/jira/crm/marketing/ticketing/agent_assist. Extend: add apns/fcm/web_push/email adapters + DeliveryChannel.PUSH.

systems.name: runtime_supervisor_and_jobs
systems.detail: WorkerSupervisor + WorkerSpec (restart/backoff, required=True aborts prod startup), role-gated; durable jobs tables. Reuse for continuation TTL sweeper + client-sync projector WorkerSpecs.

systems.name: realtime
systems.detail: SSE + WS + channel-protocol WS; monotonic cursors accepted but SERVER-SIDE REPLAY DEFERRED. Reuse as optional push transport; client-sync provides the durable catch-up.

systems.name: exploration_context_v1
systems.detail: Canonical URL-backed exploration context, TS/Python twins, parity-tested. Continuation references/rehydrates it; never stores the whole graph.

systems.name: saved_views
systems.detail: Table exploration_saved_views (BaseRepository/JSONB, tenant-qualified id). Continuation stores saved_view_id and rehydrates.

systems.name: noesis_conversations
systems.detail: Durable (conversations.py, table noesis_conversations) + ephemeral (conversation.py). Continuation references the DURABLE store. Note: two classes both named NoesisConversationStore — do NOT add a third.

systems.name: continuation_plane
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Direct-SQL + alembic (BaseRepository can't CAS). Tables continuations + continuation_selections. Routes /v1/continuations (tenant) + /v1/kyber/continuations (operator). The 'backend selection token' the in-code marker (frontend/aether/.../noesis/exploration-context.ts::exactContextHandoffLimitations) asks for lives here.

systems.name: client_sync_feed
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Durable append-only sync_change_log + sync_cursor_counter (gapless per-scope seq). GET /v1/client-sync?cursor=. Emits exactly 10 change types. Hybrid producers: explicit enqueue at mutation sites + projector on existing durable topics.

systems.name: push_provider_adapters
systems.detail: NET-NEW. No APNs/FCM/VAPID anywhere; email is enum-only (no registered adapter). Each with provider-shaped local fake; secrets via credential platform; fakes impossible in production.

systems.name: installation_push_model
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Extends services/auth/sessions + services/kyber/devices with native installations + push subscriptions (encrypted+hashed tokens). No mobile push identity exists today.

systems.name: kyber_ops_command_plane
systems.detail: Full request->dry-run->approve->execute->verify (postcondition re-read) lifecycle; registry rejects specs w/o verification_checks. Mobile Tier 0-3 ADAPTS to /v1/kyber/ops/commands (C7, staged). No new command plane.

systems.name: kyber_identity_device_sessions_access
systems.detail: OIDC+PKCE, WebAuthn + P-256 device proof, durable sessions + step-up, capabilities/roles/scopes. Mobile operator auth EXTENDS (native client + native attestation); device-proof reused for command signing.

systems.name: tenant_auth_and_authz
systems.detail: Opaque bearer session, route-policy hook, per-tenant quota. Mobile tenant auth EXTENDS with native PKCE client + device registration.

systems.name: credential_platform
systems.detail: CredentialBackend ABC + service; backends in_memory/local_encrypted/aws_secrets_manager. Store push tokens + provider secrets here. config/credential_contracts.yaml REFERENCES it (no duplication). PR #498 extends it in parallel.

systems.name: desktop_notification_center_kyber
systems.detail: Full operator notification center; NOTIFICATIONS.md lists 'Mobile push' as 'Architecture-Ready'. Reuse; add continuation receipt visibility (C6, staged).

systems.name: desktop_notification_center_aether
systems.detail: Aether desktop has ONLY settings/notifications-section.tsx today. Notification center + 'continue on phone' UI is NET-NEW (C5, staged this session).

systems.name: react_native_observation_sdk
systems.detail: Observation/analytics SDK (@aether/react-native). PRESERVE as-is; do NOT turn it into an application. Mobile apps are new workspaces under apps/.

systems.name: release_readiness_machinery
systems.detail: Reuse + extend: add mobile/continuity dimensions to production_status AREAS (staged); add Make targets; follow ICP program-ledger precedent.

systems.name: credential_contracts_registry
systems.detail: NET-NEW config (not a new system): references credential platform, declares apns/fcm/web_push_vapid/email_ses/apple_signing/google_play_signing slots with local_fake + production_fake_forbidden + activation_smoke + evidence_required.

systems.name: notification_delivery_ts_twins
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Notification/delivery are Python-only today. All new wire contracts MUST be snake_case (the parity scraper cannot capture camelCase).

systems.name: mobile_apps
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Expo + prebuild, committed native iOS/Android. Distinct bundle ids/audiences/storage; no Kyber code in Aether binary. C4 delivers compiling shells; full feature screens are C5-C6 (staged).

systems.name: mobile_shared_packages
systems.detail: NET-NEW. Must be wired into npm workspaces + bump_version + check_version_consistency + validate_ts_public_exports or the version/export gates fail.

systems.name: governed_mobile_actions
systems.detail: Tier 0-3 challenge/step-up/device-sign adapting services/kyber/ops. Not built this session.

systems.name: mobile_compliance_distribution
systems.detail: Privacy manifests, Data Safety, account-deletion flows, TestFlight/Play/Managed-Google-Play pipelines. Not built this session; externally credential-blocked.

systems.name: adversarial_review
systems.detail: Independent review lenses + remediation + final release evidence. Landed at M8 final tip (six-lens review + refute pass + remediation + final gate).
